newsitem.title: UK: London palladium fixes at six-week high.
newsitem.headline: London palladium fixes at six-week high.

text.p: Palladium was fixed at $120.50 per ounce on Thursday up from $118.75 the previous afternoon.
It was its highest fixing since October 4 this year.

The price reflected steady buying of the metal since the world's leading platinum group metals refiner Johnson Matthey forecast a 130,000-ounce deficit in palladium supply this year after a surplus last year of 240,000 ounces.
London palladium fixes at six-week high
"It looks comfortable for now at over $120.00," one dealer said.
Palladium is used in autocatalysts for cleaning up poisonous car exhaust gases, in dentistry and in a variety if hi-tech electronic applications.
Its main sources of supply are Russia and South Africa while Japan is the leading importer of the rare white metal.
